strong.purpose: main loop, the subagent default (dispatch.json's defaultTier), architecture, hard debugging

light.purpose: the opt-in tier for mechanical work, named deliberately rather than inherited: mechanical multi-file edits, summaries, digests, classification, grep-and-report

tiersUnbound.confidential: No provider with egress class "confidential" is installed. Binding this tier to a public provider would make the word meaningless, so it is left unbound: naming it fails loudly instead of quietly sending confidential material to a third party. Run scripts/install.sh and select databricks (or another endpoint inside your boundary) to bind it.
